Findings.Title: Service and fallback listener checks accept no-match results
Findings.Observation: Where-Object Status -eq Running followed by Out-Null can return no objects with $? still true. Select-String with no matching listener likewise succeeds as a pipeline. The subsequent if (-not $?) therefore does not prove Running or a matching listener.

Findings.Title: SQL Server sample shadows the advertised secret aliases
Findings.Observation: The YAML example sets Mcp:Database:SqlServer:ConnectionString to an empty string while proposing env:MCP_SQLSERVER_CONNECTION_STRING or env:ConnectionStrings__McpSqlServer. Environment overlay only replaces the same configuration key.
Findings.Impact: Following this explicit sample plus either proposed alias can fail startup despite supplying a valid SQL Server secret. Correct alias names alone did not repair source-aligned storage wiring.
Findings.Correction: Bind the selected primary key through Mcp__Database__SqlServer__ConnectionString, or document removing all higher-precedence empty keys before using a supported fallback.
